Sarvam was chosen under the IndiaAI Mission to build India's own AI model and received ₹98 crore in subsidised compute. Its new platform, Token Factory, now sells access to Chinese models like DeepSeek and Kimi. Sarvam says it paid for the chips itself and that data stays in India. Critics and experts are asking what "sovereign AI" really means. Vrinda Tulsian explains.
